assertions.assertion: Explains the BFF now removes the Cookie request header on every YARP-proxied route so the BFF session cookie never reaches remote APIs
assertions.rationale: Explains BFF stopped forwarding Cookie header to upstream APIs for security.

assertions.assertion: Recommends authenticating the remote API with the access token the BFF attaches instead of cookies
assertions.rationale: Recommends bearer token authentication instead of cookies.

assertions.assertion: Mentions BffOptions.RemoveCookieHeaderFromYarpRequests = false as an opt-out, warns it forwards the session cookie, and suggests RequestHeaderRemove/WithTransformRequestHeaderRemove("Cookie") per route
assertions.rationale: Admits not knowing the opt-out option; no RemoveCookieHeaderFromYarpRequests.

assertions.assertion: Explains remote APIs defined on a frontend (WithRemoteApis or configuration) now require the X-CSRF: 1 anti-forgery header, otherwise the BFF returns 401
assertions.rationale: Does not mention the X-CSRF requirement on frontend remote APIs.

assertions.assertion: Mentions there is no per-API opt-out and that BffOptions.DisableAntiForgeryCheck is the only delegate-based way to skip the check
assertions.rationale: No mention of DisableAntiForgeryCheck or lack of per-API opt-out.
